== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Death]]-[[madra]] is a lethal and corrosive form of energy characterized by its sickly, putrid, or icy properties. It is capable of causing severe physical and spiritual harm, such as eroding a person's life from within, consuming their essence, or corroding flesh. When used in combat, it can manifest as a wave of power that obliterates attacks or as a lethal field surrounding an object. The energy can also be combined with other elements, such as [[water]] and venom, to create vile liquid mixtures. While it is often associated with dread and intimidation—such as in the construction of massive, imposing walls—it can also exist in unusual circumstances, such as alongside living flesh. In its most concentrated forms, it acts as a powerful force that can wipe out many attacks at once or seep into a person to cause internal damage.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[Death]] [[madra]] is a substance possessed by [[Lindon]] that can manifest as a green web or be vented into the air. This energy may possess a [[hunger aspects|hunger aspect]] and can erode life, even having the capability to wipe out attacks instantly. [[Lindon]] collects this [[madra]] as [[dead matter]], gathering puffs released by the death of [[hungry ghouls|ghouls]]. The power can fill an entire room and appears as a pale, spectral green glow. It is utilized in various forms, including condensed beams, dense rivers within a [[Striker binding]], and through [[resonance]] between a trident and a heart-shaped [[binding]].}}
